assumptions.statement_zh: 法定控制指标、道路红线、权属、市政与工程约束等，须以官方附件确认后方可用于法定用途。
assumptions.statement_en: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact_zh: 本成果仅可对官方提供的边界与提交的设计图层作为正式AI征集成果评审；法定控制仍需专业人员确认。
assumptions.impact_en: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement_zh: 总体设计范围与三处重点区（众智园/原点社区/大钟寺）边界均为依据公告文字与公开信息推定的临时范围，官方多边形待发布；所有几何与指标均须在官方边界发布后整体重算。
assumptions.statement_en: The site boundary and the three key areas are provisional polygons inferred from public information; official polygons are pending, so the entire geometry and all metrics must be recalculated once they are released.
assumptions.impact_zh: 提交的所有几何与指标仅代表临时设计范围，不得用于精确面积主张、法定审批、正式评分或实施依据。
assumptions.impact_en: All submitted geometry and metrics reflect the provisional scope only and must not be used for precise area claims, statutory approval, formal scoring, or implementation basis.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三处轨道节点（大钟寺站/五道口站/清华东路西口站）的位置为概念设计的近似定位节点，待官方站点与市政数据核对后调整。
assumptions.statement_en: The three transit station nodes (Dazhongsi / Wudaokou / Qinghuadonglu Xikou) are approximate design nodes; their locations are pending confirmation against official station and civil data.
assumptions.impact_zh: 站点一体化设计为概念方案，站点位置与换乘衔接须以官方站点、轨道与市政资料为准。
assumptions.impact_en: Station-integration design is conceptual; station siting and interchange arrangements must follow official station, rail, and municipal data.

assumptions.statement_zh: 建筑底图为设计地块示意，非实测建筑；建筑高度与层数均为概念估算，待官方数据补齐。
assumptions.statement_en: Building footprints are design blocks, not surveyed buildings; heights and floor counts are estimates pending official data.
assumptions.impact_zh: 309个建筑轮廓与1,601,856 m²基底面积为设计概念值，不得作为现状普查、拆迁量或工程结论依据。
assumptions.impact_en: The 309 footprints and 1,601,856 m² footprint area are design-concept values and must not be treated as surveyed stock, demolition quantities, or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率、建筑高度、密度、绿地率等控规指标待官方规划管理条件发布后确认，本方案仅给出概念建议区间。
assumptions.statement_en: FAR, height, density, and green-ratio controls are pending official regulatory planning conditions; this proposal offers only concept-level suggested ranges.
assumptions.impact_zh: 对应指标（floor_area_ratio、building_height_m、building_density、green_ratio_control）在metrics.json中标记为unknown，不构成本方案的承诺值。
assumptions.impact_en: The corresponding metrics (floor_area_ratio, building_height_m, building_density, green_ratio_control) are marked unknown in metrics.json and are not committed values of this proposal.

assumptions.statement_zh: 红榜评价与运营机制（日常公测班次/季度公榜/年度红榜大会、双月公议会、月度场景开放日等）为概念运营建议，不构成对任何机构的实施承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Red-list evaluation and operations (daily public-test runs, quarterly public ranking, annual Red List Congress, bimonthly public deliberation, monthly scenario open days) are concept suggestions, not commitments to any institution.
assumptions.impact_zh: 运营内容用于说明设计意图与空间支撑，不作为可执行的合作协议或政府承诺。
assumptions.impact_en: Operations content illustrates design intent and spatial support only; it is not an executable agreement or a government commitment.
